notes.title: [ Full English Version ] & [ Big Sale!!! ] in November 20th!
notes.content:
[h3]Thank you very much for your patience!
The English translation version is finally complete![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37844113/9a5fc7269d4599e26b068e5e543dff7924407dd3.jpg[/img]

[h1][What type of game is it?][/h1]
An adventurous visual novel game where you use Facial Expression Analysis Mode, Liar Mode, and Deduction Mode to resolve incidents.
In this crime mystery game you delve into a realistic world with unique characters and authentic situations to deduct.
You will interrogate all suspects to determine anything “suspicious” about their given testimonies.
However, not all of them are guilty. Deduce the meaning of each expression to find the lies and facts of each case. Only then can you reveal the Truth.

[h1][Game play][/h1]
You can play as Patrick Truth, a “lie catcher” who uses gestures, voice and facial expressions to detect deception!

[h2]1. Interrogation Mode[/h2]
There are 2 ways to interrogate your suspects. Solve the case in a way that suits your style!
【Detective Focus style】
Leave the facial expression analysis to Patrick so that you can focus on determining the authenticity of given testimonies.
【Facial Expression Analysis style】
Play an active role in facial expression analysis and Patrick will provide clues for determining the authenticity of given testimonies.

[h2]2. Liar Mode[/h2]
“A lie to expose the lie”――. When you suspect a given testimony you can test a suspect’s reaction using by telling them  provocative lies!
The suspect’s reactions and facial expressions……will provide clues when deducing!

[h2]3. Deduction Mode[/h2]
Finally, resolve the case on 'Deduction Mode'! First decipher the real  order of events with reasoning.
Then deduce each individual element of the case and expose the Real Culprit!!!

notes.title: Update of ver1.3
notes.content:
1. The log screen has been made easier to see "Index" and "Details"!
When you select an item, the other side will scroll to that place!

2. "Log Hint" have been added to important log!
This is a hint that Patrick gives for "hard to notice", use it for deduction!

notes.title: Update of ver1.2
notes.content:
Hi, games are easier to play!
1. On the result screen of facial expression analysis, the type of facial expression is displayed in animation, and information about the true/false type is also added.
2. I've added and added some points to the scenarios.
3. Bug fixes and other minor improvements.

notes.title: English Demo has been released!
notes.content:
I’m Omogane Yakara, a game author.
English demo version has been released!
Let's get it by "Download Demo" button.
You can play Case No.1  in English !

I'm excited to see if everyone can enjoy it.
If you're interested, add it to your wishlist!

notes.title: Update of ver1.1
notes.content:
Added "Entrust" to "Facial Expression Discovery Mode" to fully automate the analysis.
"Characteristics and movements" have been added to the "expression model".
Added "View again" button on the result screen of facial expression analysis.
Reduce the font size of the log screen.
Speed up text auto mode.
Increased "life recovery amount" during breaks.
